transcript.line: — DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.
ROUND 2!
👄 The Eater's turn
👄 SMACKING — audible chewing from a mile off. It eats forage (300 kcal). The belly swells. (+0 damage growth. Total eaten: 600 kcal. Poison the meal, starve the field, or end it.)
ROUND 3!
👄 The Eater's turn
👄 SMACKING — audible chewing from a mile off. It eats forage (300 kcal). The belly swells. (+0 damage growth. Total eaten: 900 kcal. Poison the meal, starve the field, or end it.)
ROUND 4!
👄 The Eater's turn
👄 SMACKING — audible chewing from a mile off. It eats forage (300 kcal). The belly swells. (+0 damage growth. Total eaten: 1200 kcal. Poison the meal, starve the field, or end it.)
💥 It slams through!
You slip aside — it misses clean. (footwork)
📖 Codex: Smack-Rush — charges in a straight line, trampling everything in its path. You won't forget this.
ROUND 5!
👄 The Eater's turn
👄 SMACKING — audible chewing from a mile off. It eats forage (300 kcal). The belly swells. (+0 damage growth. Total eaten: 1500 kcal. Poison the meal, starve the field, or end it.)
Travel 1 tile to meadow.
Something pads into the clearing — The Eulogy. It's here.
Something big is moving in the woods. The birds went quiet.
🚪 BARRIER CROSSED — you crash through to a new area, but they're right behind you — through the barrier! (The edge of the grid is an exit. The chase continues.)
The Eater is flagging — it won't follow much further.
ROUND 6!
👄 The Eater's turn
👄 SMACKING — audible chewing from a mile off. It eats forage (300 kcal). The belly swells. (+0 damage growth. Total eaten: 1800 kcal. Poison the meal, starve the field, or end it.)
ROUND 7!
👄 The Eater's turn
👄 SMACKING — audible chewing from a mile off. It eats forage (300 kcal). The belly swells. (+0 damage growth. Total eaten: 2100 kcal. Poison the meal, starve the field, or end it.)
💥 Smack-Rush!
Armor absorbs 42.
Eater's Smack-Rush hits you for 25.
The Eater is on you — no warning, just teeth.
Armor absorbs 28.
The Eater hits you for 17.
You go down.
OH. Oh no. ...The gamblers are very quiet.
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Yara Haddad is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
🕯️ Yara Haddad is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
What Yara kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
"Yara's gone." Sari looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Yara." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Mara blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
📖 LEARNED: Calming Panic (Level 1). Ground them: 5 things you see, 4 you hear, 3 you touch. Breathe with them. Slow is fast.
📖 LEARNED: Managing Fear (Level 1). Fear is data, not orders. Acknowledge it, then decide anyway. Courage is fear that kept going.
📖 LEARNED: Camp Cooking (Level 1). Cooking uses half the water, +10% kcal. Once per day: add a Secret Ingredient (a random inventory item) — 50% delicious (+morale), 50% educational.
📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.

The warm hum behind your ribs is gone. The reactor went with Yara's body — it does not come out, and it does not pass on. Hunger is back on the table. (One reactor per world, and the world already spent its one.)
🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
📖 The Codex turns a page: Yara Haddad, 116 days. The mantle passes to Mara Vasquez.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Mara Vasquez, 52 — an army medic. Her hands know different work now: Iron Stomach, Pyrokinesis, War Cry, Green Whisper, Green Thumb, Literally, Cornucopia.
◈ The System updates its file: the new bearer <redacted> "Gardener of the Living Garden." It had a word for this one before the Codex came.
The village's quarrel was with Yara — and Yara is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
You knew Yara — not the office, the person. The fire keeps expecting her, and so do you. That's a heavier kind of stepping up. (+5 trauma)
At the grave, Sari, Naran, Jesse and 1 more speak for Mara — "Yara trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
The fire knew Mara before the Codex did — her name already carried weight here.
